features.title: Browse aliases by scope and environment
features.summary: Search metadata-only aliases across all, project, global, and local scopes; choose projects through the shared picker and identify the current host-local scope.

configuration.constraints: One of all, project, global, or local.

failureModes: Duplicate alias and environment across scopes makes value operations unavailable.
A scope without a selected folder cannot claim project-specific results.

externalDependencies.boundary: Managed secret CLI list/read operations and local vault metadata.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Inject a fake CLI runner with synthetic alias metadata and values; never read a real vault or session credential.

verification.testName: filters All, Project, Global, and Local metadata scopes
requires a selected folder for project/local rows and blocks ambiguous alias/environment actions
projects only value-free metadata from the CLI JSON contract
routes picker browsing and workspace registration through the Host Remote contracts

features.title: Reveal and copy an exact secret value
features.summary: Reveal one exact alias and environment only on demand, permit a bounded preview/full/hidden cycle, and clear plaintext on timeout, blur, scope change, refresh, or unmount.

configuration.constraints: Integer from 0 to 60 seconds; zero keeps the notice persistent.
Boolean; clear revealed values when focus leaves the view.

failureModes: Secret values are never included in catalog metadata, argv, or notices.
Blur or navigation clears client plaintext before another reveal.

externalDependencies.boundary: Exact alias/environment read through the managed secret executable.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Return synthetic test-only secret strings through injected CLI and clipboard adapters; never set or read real secret environment values.

verification.testName: runs reveal and clipboard copy only when exact alias methods are called
cycles from preview to full to hidden
previews long values at both ends and keeps short values masked
does not expose CLI stdout for copy and mutation commands

features.title: Create, edit, rename, and remove aliases safely
features.summary: Create generated or manual values, edit metadata/value, rename aliases, remove one alias without deleting the vault item, or explicitly delete the vault entry.
failureModes: Duplicate alias/environment collisions are blocked before writes.
Manual values travel through stdin and are not echoed in process output.

externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Assert fixed argv and synthetic stdin/output with an injected runner; do not invoke Bitwarden or external vault services.

verification.testName: keeps a generated value out of the request and omits blank metadata
passes a manual value through unchanged
requires a second explicit action before removing an alias or deleting its vault item
requires a review step before replacing an existing value
renames an alias in its own config before editing it under the new name
keeps project alias removal distinct from global item deletion
adds manual local aliases over stdin without putting their values in argv or output

features.title: Expose safe secret catalog tools to agents
features.summary: List aliases as metadata only and retrieve a value only for one explicitly requested alias and environment.
failureModes: Ambiguous aliases and missing scopes fail closed.
